name: session_create_response.v1
description: POST /v1/sessions 201 response (docs/13 §1, §2.1): the standard REST envelope with data = the connect bundle. Forward compatibility (docs/13 §9): new response fields are additive within v1 and clients MUST ignore fields they do not recognize — which is why this schema deliberately does not set additionalProperties: false anywhere.

success.description: true iff HTTP 2xx (docs/13 §1). Redundant with the status code on purpose — the body carries its own verdict because mobile HTTP stacks and interceptors mangle status codes.

meta.description: null everywhere except paginated list endpoints (docs/13 §1).

connect_bundle.description: Everything the client needs to connect: mint happened server-side (session id, hashed one-time signaling token in Redis, computed TURN credential pair) before this body is returned (docs/13 §2.1).

session_id.description: The session id, e.g. 'a1f3c9' — also the suffix of the TURN username (docs/13 §7).

signaling_url.description: wss:// URL of the voice-worker SignalingServer; the client connects with ?session_id=<id>&token=<signaling_token> (docs/13 §6).

signaling_token.description: Opaque one-time token ('st_…'), 5-min TTL, stored SHA-256-hashed in Redis, verified and burned at WS accept before any SDP is read (docs/13 §6.2).

ice_servers.description: Passed verbatim to PeerConnection construction on the client — STUN entry first (credential-free), then the coturn TURN entry with its HMAC credential pair (docs/13 §2.1, §7).

expires.description: The signaling token's connect deadline (5-min TTL, docs/13 §6.2) — NOT the session's lifetime.

ice_server.description: One RTCIceServer entry. The STUN entry carries only urls; the TURN entry adds the coturn use-auth-secret credential pair (docs/13 §7).

urls.description: stun:/turn:/turns: URIs; for TURN, udp on 3478 first, tls on 5349 fallback (docs/13 §7).

username.description: TURN REST-API credential username '<expiry_unix_ts>:<session_id>', e.g. '1784537062:a1f3c9' — the expiry travels inside the username; 10-min TTL (docs/13 §7). Absent on the STUN entry.

credential.description: base64(HMAC-SHA1(TURN_SECRET, username)) (docs/13 §7). Absent on the STUN entry.
